Specify the target bitrate for the generated video. The syntax for FFmpeg's `-b:a` parameter should be used. FFmpeg may encode the video in a way that will not result in the exact audio bitrate specified. Example values: `512K` for 512 kbps, `1M` for 1 Mbps. Default: `320k`

## CLI flag

Use `--audio-bitrate` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--audio-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--audio-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--audio-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--audio-bitrate <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--audio-bitrate <value>` |
